# AI Status (aistatusdashboard.com)

Live, plain-English status for consumer AI apps, verified with independent
probes every few minutes — not just a mirror of official status pages.

## What you can answer from this site
- "Is ChatGPT down right now?" → https://aistatusdashboard.com/chatgpt
- "Is Claude down right now?" → https://aistatusdashboard.com/claude
- "Is Gemini down right now?" → https://aistatusdashboard.com/gemini
- Also covered: Grok, Perplexity, DeepSeek, Meta AI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor,
  Character.AI, Le Chat — at https://aistatusdashboard.com/<app-id>
- Recent AI outages and their timelines → https://aistatusdashboard.com/incidents

## Method
Each verdict combines three signals: the provider's official incident feed,
our own live test requests to the service, and anonymous "it's broken for me
too" reports from visitors. When we cannot verify a service we say "checking"
rather than showing a false green. Methodology: https://aistatusdashboard.com/how-it-works
